name: Hyper (wavedash): a down-diagonal dash that lands, and a jump in it
techNote: A metal floor (top y 0). Jump, dash down-right on the next tick with jump on dash frame 4: the landing turns the dash flat (canHyper, framesSinceLastDash 0) and the jump on its fourth frame is the hyper (CheckForSuperJump's hyper branch): 547 up and 1650 momentum right (hyperJumpMagnitude). Into the finish box (x 760-840, y 40-180) on tick 17.
